Title: Resetting Your Password
Content: To reset your password, go to Settings > Security and click Forgot Password. You will receive a reset link by email valid for 24 hours.

Title: Refund Policy
Content: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number to request a refund.

Title: Upgrading Your Plan
Content: You can upgrade your subscription plan anytime from the Billing page. Changes take effect immediately and are prorated.

Title: Canceling Your Subscription
Content: To cancel, go to Billing > Manage Subscription and click Cancel. You retain access until the end of the billing period.

Title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
Content: Enable two-factor authentication in Settings > Security. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app to complete setup.

Title: Exporting Your Data
Content: Export all your account data as a CSV or JSON file from Settings > Data Export. Large exports are emailed as a download link.

Title: Contacting Support
Content: Reach our support team via the in-app chat or email support@example.com. Response time is typically within one business day.
